botPolicy: Existing BotPlayer scoring unchanged for both runs
notes: The scenario manifest fixes deck IDs, order, Capital IDs and seeds across versions.
Roster decks contain one copy of all 64 faction cards; these are coverage decks, not optimized decks.
Each ordered faction pair plays the three matching-index Capital pairs; not all nine Capital pairings.
Ally scenarios use the first 32 cards of each faction, against the ally faction starter.
Faction wins/games includes draws, mirrors and allied-deck scenarios.
seatZeroWinRate measures seating among completed games, not the initiative winner.
Before report field firstPlayerWinRate was relabeled seatZeroWinRate without altering any values.
Card deckAppearances counts player-deck inclusions once per ID, not copies; plays are actual CARD_PLAYED events.
Baseline source catalogs and Capital behavior are from the baseline commit, with the same corrected hex simulation harness.
